# Tally

> Tally is a command-line tool that turns bank CSV exports into a monthly spending summary.

Free for personal use. Runs locally; no data leaves the machine.

## Product

- [Home](https://tally.example.com/): what Tally does and who it is for
- [Launch post](https://tally.example.com/blog/hello.html): benchmarks and beta results

## Optional

- [GitHub](https://github.com/example/tally): source code and supported bank formats
